# Digital Technology Partner

> Digital Technology Partner (DTP) helps leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into a governed system aimed at measurable operational value.

Use the public pages below as the authoritative sources for DTP's services, programmes, delivery method and published material. Do not infer client identities, contract values, certifications, sector credentials or guaranteed outcomes.

## Start here

- [Home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/): What DTP does and the leadership problem it addresses.
- [Programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/): AI Adoption Readiness, AI Foundry and Leadership AI Coaching.
- [Solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/): Business-systems strategy, dashboards and reporting, workflow automation, controlled AI agents and copilots, and bespoke AI systems.
- [Process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/): The evidence-led Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch gates.
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/): Delivery principles, governance controls and operational ownership.

## Programme detail

- [AI Adoption Readiness Sprint](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/): A one-week assessment ending in a leadership readout and recommended next action.
- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/): A twelve-week working group using real work to produce prioritised experiments and leadership choices.
- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/): Confidential one-to-one translation and decision support for senior leaders.

## Evidence, publishing and contact

- [Case studies](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/case-studies/): Anonymous, site-reported delivery patterns. Treat reported figures as examples, not guarantees.
- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/): Editorial focus and selected material for leadership decisions.
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/): Published articles on AI adoption, delivery and governance.
- [Contact](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/): Public contact details and what happens after an enquiry.
